is a Japanese manga series written by Saiko Wadori and illustrated by Mika Kajiyama. It began serialization in Akita Shoten's shōjo manga magazine Princess in February 2019.
Publication
Written by Saiko Wadori and illustrated by Mika Kajiyama, ''His Majesty the Demon King's Housekeeper'' began serialization in Akita Shoten's shōjo manga magazine Princess on February 6, 2019. Its chapters were collected into twelve tankōbon volumes as of May 2025. The series is licensed in English by Seven Seas Entertainment.
